observation_limits: The exported morsel helper has no direct query caller in the inspected repository; its correction is not a measured query improvement.

The direct-thread Parquet reader is production code only with universal-format-io and without vortex-write; release-user-surfaces exercises it as test code. Shared native ingest retains its existing executor.
Tests attach real memory leases to worker-owned test guards to observe lifetime. Production allocation coverage and queue limits are unchanged.
Partial Parquet startup failures and panics are injected at the spawner boundary. Real operating-system thread exhaustion and morsel spawn failure were not induced.

The morsel scope provides a worker-body lifetime guarantee during caller-side startup unwind; automatic scope cleanup does not certify completion of arbitrary thread-local destructors or threads created inside user callbacks.

Joining waits for synchronous callbacks or reads to finish or unwind. It does not interrupt blocked callbacks or recover aborts, add global CPU/I/O coordination, or close PERF-03/06 or any competitive gate.
No Full43, public workflow, installed-wheel or hosted check is claimed for this local worker correction. The separately accepted buffer-table evidence keeps its original source and clock.
